item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,math; from work import evaluate\\n\\ndef check(req, pol, exp):\\n a=copy.deepcopy(req); b=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==exp,(got,exp); assert req==a and pol==b\\np={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'b','amount':300,'unit':'cm'}]},p,{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'b','amount':3.0}],'errors':[]})\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'x'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':'x'},{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'},{'row':4,'cause':'duplicate'}]})\\ncheck({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'y','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'z','amount':-1}]},p,{'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]})\\np2={**p,'unique':False}; check({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]},p2,{'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}],'errors':[]})\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}}" }
